items.question: In the UAE foster care programme for children of unknown parentage, what is the minimum age required for both spouses in a foster family?
items.gold: Both spouses must be at least 25 years old.
items.fact: Foster family spouses must each be at least 25 years old.

items.question: In the UAE, what should a person do immediately after finding an abandoned child?
items.gold: Take the child immediately to the nearest police station and hand him or her to the police.
items.fact: Abandoned child must be taken to nearest police station immediately.
